mapper.sql: select a.article_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.author, a.is_top, a.status, a.views, a.publish_time, a.offline_time, a.sort, a.attachment, a.keywords, a.description, a.version, a.del_flag, a.deleted_time, a.deleted_by, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, c.category_name, c.front_page from cms_article a left join cms_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from cms_article where category_id = #{categoryId} and del_flag = '0'

select a.article_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.cover, a.author, a.is_top, a.status, a.views, a.publish_time, a.offline_time, a.sort, a.attachment, a.keywords, a.description, a.version, a.del_flag, a.deleted_time, a.deleted_by, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, c.category_name, c.front_page from cms_article a left join cms_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id where a.article_id = #{articleId} and a.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update cms_article set views = views + 1 where article_id = #{articleId}

mapper.select: select sum(case when del_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as articleTotal, sum(case when del_flag = '0' and create_time >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as articleToday, sum(case when del_flag = '0' and status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as draftCount, sum(case when del_flag = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as recycleCount from cms_article

select history_id, article_id, version, category_id, title, summary, content, cover, author, is_top, status, sort, attachment, keywords, description, publish_time, update_by, update_time from cms_article_history where article_id = #{articleId} order by version desc limit 20

select history_id, article_id, version, category_id, title, summary, content, cover, author, is_top, status, sort, attachment, keywords, description, publish_time, update_by, update_time from cms_article_history where article_id = #{articleId} and version = #{version}
mapper.insert: insert into cms_article_history (article_id, version, category_id, title, summary, content, cover, author, is_top, status, sort, attachment, keywords, description, publish_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{articleId}, #{version}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{cover}, #{author}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{attachment}, #{keywords}, #{description}, #{publishTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
insert into article_views_daily (article_id, view_date, view_count) values (#{articleId}, CURDATE(), 1) on duplicate key update view_count = view_count + 1
mapper.select: select a.article_id as articleId, a.title, a.views, c.category_name as categoryName from cms_article a left join cms_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.views > 0 order by a.views desc limit #{limit}

select c.category_name as categoryName, sum(a.views) as totalViews, count(a.article_id) as articleCount from cms_article a left join cms_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id where a.del_flag = '0' and c.category_id is not null group by c.category_id, c.category_name order by totalViews desc
select v.view_date as viewDate, sum(v.view_count) as viewCount from article_views_daily v where v.view_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) group by v.view_date order by v.view_date
